notes.title: 🛠️UPDATE: Brazilian Portuguese localization support
notes.content: We've updated the game to support Brazilian Portuguese localizations.

notes.title: 🛠️Hotfix 1.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Adjusted the character Blob Raider.
[*]Adjusted the character Quartzite.
[*]Fixed an issue where the boxes would not break when playing level 18 Bookie Box with Jasper.
[*]You can now play tennis with a sword.
[/list]

notes.title: 🛠️Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the achievement "Chain Master" could not be unlocked.
[*]Fixed a problem where the volume of some sound effects did not change.
[/list]

notes.title: 🛠️Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed a problem where achievements could not be unlocked.
When you access the level select screen, the achievements that you missed due to the previous problem will be unlocked.

notes.title: 🛠️Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Steam screenshots are now supported.
[*]Fixed a problem that the game would freeze on Level 23 when using certain characters.
[*]Fixed a problem that prevented you from getting 3 stars at level 8.
[*]Fixed a problem with the CRT mode in full screen.
[*]You can now hit billiard balls with a sword.
[/list]
